findings.detail: Leaked dictionary apparatus: the trailing "‘someone’])" is the tail of kaikki's argument-structure note "(optional [with mit (+ dative) ‘someone’])", cut mid-bracket. As shipped it is not English about the verb. Sich verloben means to become engaged to be married.

The importer took kaikki's second sense (index 1). "cease doing" names a different action — that is aufhören. Verlernen means to lose a skill through lack of practice: Ich habe mein Französisch verlernt. Sense index 0 has it right: lose the ability to do a task due to rarely doing it. Because the house comma reads as "these mean the same thing", the shipped gloss presents stopping and forgetting-how as equivalents.

Verlöschen as a learner meets it is intransitive: die Kerze verlischt, das Feuer verlosch — the flame or light dies out on its own. The transitive "extinguish" is löschen (or auslöschen); glossing the ver- verb as "quench, extinguish" invites the learner to produce *ich verlösche das Feuer. The intransitive reading is candidate index 1.

Verlauten is reportive and subjectless in normal use — wie aus Regierungskreisen verlautet, es verlautete, dass… — so the meaning runs in the opposite direction from "announce", which is what the causative verlauten lassen adds. The shipped gloss teaches the wrong argument structure for the bare verb.
Bare "spend" is ambiguous in English and, next to a German verb, reads first as spending money — which is ausgeben. Verleben takes only time as its object: den Sommer bei den Großeltern verleben.

"creep away" is a literal reading of ver- plus kriechen that keeps the manner and drops the point: sich verkriechen is about ending up hidden — sich ins Bett / unter die Decke verkriechen, said of a person who withdraws from the world. Candidate index 1 ("to hide away, to be holed up") names the sense in use; as shipped the gloss collides with wegschleichen.

The shortening kept the definitional first half of candidate index 0 and dropped the half that named the action: "particularly: to offset one against another". "calculate several quantities together" is a description of an entry rather than a usable English rendering — a learner cannot substitute it into a sentence for etwas mit etwas verrechnen.
